subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】Monday 星期一; Tuesday 星期二; Wednesday 星期三; Thursday 星期四; Friday 星期五; Saturday 星期六; Sunday 星期日; weekend 周末; wash my clothes 洗衣服; watch TV 看电视; do homework 做作业; read books 读书; play football 踢足球
【重点句型】What do you have on ...? 你们星期……有什么课？ I have ... 我有…… What do you do on the weekend? 周末你做什么？ I often ... 我经常…… I love ... 我喜欢……
【A Let's talk】Grandpa: What do you have on Thursdays? Oliver: I have maths, English and music. Grandpa: Do you often read books on the weekend? Oliver: No, I often play football.
【Read and write】I have a busy week. On Mondays I have Chinese and maths. On Wednesdays I have English and art. On the weekend I wash my clothes, watch TV and read books. I often play football with my friends.
key_points: What do you have on ...? 你们星期……有什么课？
What do you do on the weekend? 周末你做什么？
